in_sanskrit.name: Kanagaraj
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God of Wealth
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Kanagaraj एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Lord of Prosperity and Wealth, God of Trade and Commerce

in_hindi.name: कनहाराज
in_hindi.meaning: कना (कनपूर) और राज (राजा) से संगेत हुए
in_hindi.long_meaning: This name is derived from Tamil words 'Kana' meaning sacred ash and 'Raj' meaning rule. In Hindi, it is pronounced as 'कनहाराज' and its meaning is 'one who rules over the sacred ash' or 'ruler of sacred ash'.

in_tamil.name: கனகராஜ

in_telugu.name: కనగరాజ
